GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then hampered, lost a length and Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # hampered early

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.25 Lengths on fence, railed up to 1.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn , shifted Two Wide Straightening Up with a clear gap available, wasn't good enough to come on and Lost Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1400m, steadied from heels. Approaching the 100m, eased when disappointed for a run.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1 length joint Lead on fence settling down, Headed 1000m, Drifted Back (4 Lengths leader mid-race) to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground to the line # ran on okay

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths Four Wide , Made Some Ground to 7 Lengths Five Wide turning, steered to centre of track Straightening Up and Made Some Ground down the outside in Straight # never on track

Jumped okay & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , Moved Up to 3 Wide joint Lead turning, hit Lead Straightening Up and kept going in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards questioned rider re racing in a forward position. Jockey stated the instructions were unchanged: to pressure it from the barriers in an attempt to race in a forward position. He added it had been slowly away last start and settled back. Trainer confirmed the instructions.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When quest reg racing in a forward position, which was in contrast to most recent starts, Rdr stated instructions were similar to recent runs, to pressure gelding from gates in an attempt to be forward-added gelding had been slow away last start & settled back. Tnr confirmed instructs & said instructions were same as previous two starts, whereby gelding has been slowly away & unable to be forward over short distances-added gelding was able to obtain a forward position, which with the step up in distance was beneficial to performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths , sat back last Two Wide 12 Lengths 700m, worked into the race widest before the corner, made up many lengths last 2000m and was an eye catcher # ran on widest
Slow Out 2 Lengths , Clear last 7 Lengths 500m, came widest from the corner, Kept Coming last 100m and although never threatened was not Beaten all that far # not far away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin (2L), then slightly hampered.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1.5 Lengths & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , lost only a length in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # missed the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Leaving the home straight on the first occasion, raced in restricted room.  Raced keen early.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , out 3 Wide by the 1000m, Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, kept improving in Straight # wide/kept battling
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide throughout. Rdr dropped whip passing the 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to turn, hooked Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Inconvenienced near the 750m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Four Wide at the 350m, ran on hitting Lead at the 180m and kept going to post. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 1.0kg overweight.] # Wide run/solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Race wide for the majority. Shifted ground when under pressure passing the 200m point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths & Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths turning, improved rounding turn then shifted wider after Straightening Up , Made Good Ground in straight. [Stewards: Kicked behind barriers. Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after being kicked behind barriers. Slow to begin (2L). Approaching the 1000m became unbalanced when steadied from heels.
